title: Count Primes
description: Return the number of prime numbers strictly less than n.
outputFormat: Print the number of primes less than n.

title: Palindrome Number
description: Determine whether an integer reads the same forward and backward without converting it to a string.

examples.explanation: 121 reads the same in both directions.

title: Greatest Common Divisor
description: Return the greatest common divisor of two non-negative integers.
inputFormat: Two space-separated integers a and b

examples.explanation: 6 is the largest integer dividing both values.

title: Sqrt(x)
description: Return the integer square root of x, rounded down.

examples.explanation: The square root is between 2 and 3, so return 2.

title: Happy Number
description: Repeatedly replace n with the sum of the squares of its digits. Return whether the process reaches 1.

title: Pow(x, n)
description: Calculate x raised to the integer power n using fast exponentiation.
inputFormat: A floating-point value x and integer n
outputFormat: Print the result rounded to five decimal places.

title: Factorial Trailing Zeroes
description: Return the number of trailing zeroes in n factorial.
outputFormat: Print the number of trailing zeroes.

title: Roman to Integer
description: Convert a valid Roman numeral to its integer value.

title: Integer to Roman
description: Convert an integer to its standard Roman numeral representation.

title: Excel Sheet Column Number
description: Convert an Excel-style uppercase column title to its positive column number.
